input.domain_masks: Each cell mask is nonempty and contains only tile IDs 0 through k-1.
input.tile_weights: Each tile weight is an integer from 1 through 4.
input.adjacency_masks: For each direction and tile, a bit mask lists tiles allowed in the neighboring cell.
input.reciprocal_compatibility: North/south and east/west entries must describe the same undirected pair relation in reverse.
input.draws: One unsigned 16-bit draw per cell; used only when that cell is observed.
input.initial_propagation: Seed every cell once in row-major order; use a FIFO queue and in-queue deduplication before the first observation.

output.success_encoding: bit 32 is set; each row-major tile ID occupies two bits starting at bit 2*cell_index.

algorithm.observation: Choose a nonsingleton cell with minimum domain cardinality; ties use row-major order.
algorithm.weighted_choice: rank=floor(draw*sum(candidate_weights)/65536); scan remaining tile IDs ascending and subtract their weights.
algorithm.propagation: After each observation, seed the FIFO with the collapsed cell; when popped, revise its neighbors north/east/south/west and enqueue each changed neighbor only if not already queued.
algorithm.queue_rule: Clear the in-queue flag when popping; initialization enqueues all cells once in row-major order.
algorithm.contradiction: An empty domain returns -2 immediately; no alternative tile is tried.

workspace.meaning: Conservative fixed-workspace ceiling for all local domain, compatibility, draw, queue, and in-queue arrays.

complexity.time: O(cells * tile_types^2 + cells^2), including support propagation and repeated MRV scans
